manifest.purpose: Correct golden answer for submission/recovered_rtl.v. Defines module recovered_decoder(input [6:0] codeword, output [3:0] data, output [6:0] corrected_codeword, output error_detected) exactly matching the pinned interface. Implements: s0=codeword[0]^codeword[2]^codeword[4]^codeword[6]; s1=codeword[1]^codeword[2]^codeword[5]^codeword[6]; s2=codeword[3]^codeword[4]^codeword[5]^codeword[6]; syndrome={s2,s1,s0} as 1-indexed error bit position (0..7); error_detected = |syndrome (nonzero syndrome); corrected_codeword = codeword with bit at position (syndrome-1) flipped when syndrome!=0, else codeword unchanged (use a case/if on syndrome value 1..7 mapping to codeword[0..6]); data[3]=corrected_codeword[6], data[2]=corrected_codeword[5], data[1]=corrected_codeword[4], data[0]=corrected_codeword[2] (matches flattened_netlist.v's n14..n17 wiring). Purely combinational, all assign statements, no clock/always. This exactly reproduces inputs/flattened_netlist.v behavior for all 128 codewords, verified by construction against the netlist's XOR fan-ins (n1..n6, _T_1..3) and flip-mask logic (n_flip[1..7]) and data taps (corrected_codeword[6],[5],[4],[2]).
